title: EventBus post-exception repeated emit recovery contract

contract.post_exception_recovery: EventBus remains operational after a listener callback raises during broadcast
contract.repeated_emit_continuity: Subsequent EventBus.emit() calls remain successful after the callback failure
contract.callback_exception_isolation: A callback exception does not poison later event delivery cycles
contract.delivery_continuity: All currently registered listeners continue receiving subsequent emitted events
contract.delivery_once: Each registered listener receives each emitted event exactly once
contract.source_metadata: Each delivered event preserves the source plugin_id supplied to emit()
contract.registry_integrity: Repeated emits after callback failure do not modify or corrupt the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: Event emission and listener registration require the events permission
